d: Sundarkand mulat valmiki krit ramayan ka ek bhag (kand ya sopan) hai. gosvami tulsidas krit shri ram charit manas tatha any bhashaon ke ramayan men bhi sundarkand upasthit hai. sundarkand men hanumanji dvara kiye gaye mahan karyon ka varnan hai. ramayan path men sundarkand ke path ka vishesh mahatv mana jata hai. sundarkand men hanumanji ka lanka prasthan, lanka dahan se lanka se vapsi tak ke ghatnakram aate hain. is sopan ke mukhy ghatnakram hai – hanumanji ka lanka ki or prasthan, vibhishan se bhent, sita se bhent karke unhen shri ram ki mudrika dena, akshay kumar ka vadh, lanka dahan…
